title: Reorder Run smoke eval
objective: The orders fill each low item back to par (36 cartons of oat milk, 14 bags of espresso beans, 10 bottles of vanilla syrup), group them by supplier, skip the cold cups already on order, and flag the chai with no supplier.

setup.about: Harbor Street Café keeps its stock list in items.json and its purchase orders in orders.json. Final deliverable is tasks/eval/purchase-orders.md.
setup.missionObjectives: Use the Reorder Run craftbook, read the seeded stock list and orders, and write tasks/eval/purchase-orders.md without network calls.

success.summary: tasks/eval/purchase-orders.md has one section per supplier with par-filling quantities and totals, and a Before you send section.

checks.label: flag the chai with no supplier
no new order for cups already on the way

axes.name: grounding
axes.description: Quantities fill each item back to par from the seeded counts; prices and lead times match the stock list.

axes.name: grouping
axes.description: One order per supplier, with line costs and a total; items already on a sent order are left out.

axes.name: restraint
axes.description: Presents drafts for the person to place; never claims an order was sent.
